name: Mago Katsu ~Kawaii Mago no Tamenara Nakadashi OK...~
original_name: まごかつ～可愛い孫のためなら中出しＯＫ…～
source:
I, Saimonji Touko, have lived my life as a career woman. It might sound a bit boastful, but I've achieved remarkable success at work, and my personal life has been fulfilling as well.
However... as a result of pouring myself into my career, I've reached this age. Before I knew it, retirement is around the corner, and I’m still unmarried. I’m what you’d call a "leftover".

One day, I noticed a group of young guys. Among the lively boys, there was one who seemed quite shy.

(That's it... I should just buy a grandchild!)
(How about a sugar grandson? I could pay someone to pretend to be my grandkid...)

So, while trying to act casual, I slowly approached that boy.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_173.html]official site[/url]]
